answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and treating coordinated equivocation as a correlated event: if k identities sign conflicting histories, aggregate slashing grows O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake. Thus an onyx operator cannot cheaply echo votes across a mesa of aliases; escrow depletion and asymmetric depreciation make larger swarms progressively uneconomic.
